high_level_description: The image depicts a pottery studio with a person sitting on a wooden bench in front of a pottery wheel. The individual is wearing a green long-sleeve shirt and white overalls, which are covered in clay, indicating they have been working with clay. They are holding a glass of what appears to be a light-colored beverage, possibly water or a drink, and seem to be taking a break from their work. The pottery wheel in front of the person has a partially formed clay pot on it. The studio is cluttered with various pottery items and tools.
